item.title: Brandon Flowers’ ‘Thrasher’ came out two months ago, but LP4…
item.author: Stereogum (@stereogum.com)
item.description: Brandon Flowers’ ‘Thrasher’ came out two months ago, but LP4 is already on the way. Tonight, the Killers frontman debuted a song titled “A Good Man Is Hard To Find” (after Flannery O’Connor’s short story). It’s from an album coming next year. He also debuted a cover of the Coral’s “Dreaming Of You.”
